purpose: Paired frozen baseline test of a previously observed settled 2-2 surface-pulse prefix; no production parameter fitting.
source: Fresh standard reset, auto 1652 decisions in requests of at most 240, then 24 one-decision neutral requests to reach observed settled state.
commonPrefix: Ten pairs of A for one decision then neutral for one decision. Starting action-relative frame zero is after the settled prefix.

criteria.matchedPrefix: Require frame-150 full image hashes and actual action-relative durations to match across all runs. Independently verify repeated images and frame durations per case.
criteria.image: Exact supplied opaque template only. Partial and unmatched are retained and unscored. Explicitly inspect target screenshots and distinguish visible position from physical state.
criteria.comparison: Compare each exact reference endpoint to predeclared frozen production prediction; for aligned paired exact endpoints, compare stroke-minus-neutral against frozen difference. Paired threshold 4 follows by triangle inequality from two 2px individual limits; it does not relax individual position acceptance.
criteria.limitations: Prior stroke observations are explored, not held out. This fresh intervention is a diagnostic; do not tune during or after capture. Preserve unscored poses and unchanged preexisting reports.
